# US Census Bureau TIGER/Line data

`tl_2024_11_place.dbf` and `tl_2024_11_place.cpg` come from the US Census Bureau's
TIGER/Line Shapefiles, 2024 release, Places for the District of Columbia:
https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/TIGER2024/PLACE/tl_2024_11_place.zip

TIGER/Line files are works of the United States government. Under 17 U.S.C. § 105 they
aren't subject to copyright in the United States and are in the public domain. Only the
attribute table (`.dbf`) and its code-page file (`.cpg`) are included; the geometry files
were left out. The data describes places, not people.

Source: US Census Bureau, TIGER/Line Shapefiles.
